goal: Fix the confirmed hunsu tree_fingerprint false drift between identical Claude/Codex plugin payloads caused by Codex's root .codex-marketplace-install.json installer receipt: ignore that exact root path only, keep every real content change visible, and document that locks whose hash included the receipt need an explicit relock after payload verification
brief: Make hunsu.py's tree_fingerprint leave out exactly the root-level file entry .codex-marketplace-install.json (Codex's installer receipt) and nothing else, per the contract sections; name the receipt in the function's docstring (Q-docs' last sentence). Change only tree_fingerprint in hunsu.py: test_hunsu.py is protected; hunsu.py also carries an earlier uncommitted CAPABILITY_HELP edit that is not this task's — keep it byte for byte. Do not touch README.md, plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, skills/, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md; no version bump; never read or write a real plugin cache, ~/.claude, ~/.codex or another project. python3 test_hunsu.py must pass in full (python3 3.11+).

built.summary: Changed only tree_fingerprint to exclude the exact root receipt file and name it in the docstring. Protected tests and the existing CAPABILITY_HELP edit remain unchanged. Full suite passes with AGENT_WORKER unset.
non-claims: Initial suite run failed three hook tests because inherited AGENT_WORKER=1 suppresses hook output. The successful run used unset AGENT_WORKER in its shell.
README relock documentation belongs to the separate documentation task and was not changed.

receipt-tests: Q-no-migration: "The remedy is explicit: verify the installed payload against its release, then `hunsu lock` again (or `hunsu add <plugin> --take-content \"why\"` ...)" is documented in README.md by the Q-docs task; test_hunsu.py does not assert README wording, as the contract decides.

Q-no-migration: 'computed for a fixture tree … with the current source gives 1.15.1's values' — the two literals were computed with the current hunsu.py, not cross-checked here against a separate copy of the locked 1.15.1. They rely on the session's statement that the two are byte-identical.

Q-exact-path: a case-variant root name (e.g. `.Codex-Marketplace-Install.json`) is not tested. On this case-insensitive macOS filesystem it is the same file as the receipt, so no test here can tell the two apart.

Q-cross-host is tested through the fake Claude host with a receipt added to the installed copy, or to a second copy registered as the install. No test runs `check` with AGENT_HOST=codex against a real or faked Codex plugin cache.
Q-receipt-ignored symlink case: the test raises Skip if the platform cannot make a symlink.

Already failing before these changes, and still failing on this machine: test_check_says_when_a_pinned_plugin_is_behind_a_release_available_here, test_policy_lines_materialize_every_resolution_shape_and_the_session_hook_carries_them, test_session_start_hook_reports_both_states. They fail the same way with the HEAD copy of test_hunsu.py, so `python3 test_hunsu.py` exits non-zero apart from these new tests.
